query:
-- TX-19: R runoff, D nominee confirmed (Kyle Rable)
UPDATE house_races
SET notes = 'R primary runoff May 26: Tom Sell vs. Abraham Enriquez. Winner faces Democrat Kyle Rable in the November general election.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 19;

-- TX-32: R runoff, D nominee confirmed (Dan Barrios)
UPDATE house_races
SET notes = 'R primary runoff May 26: Jace Yarbrough vs. Ryan Binkley. Winner faces Democrat Dan Barrios in the November general election.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 32;

-- TX-33: Both D and R runoffs on May 26
UPDATE house_races
SET notes = 'R primary runoff May 26: Patrick Gillespie vs. John Sims. D primary runoff May 26: Colin Allred vs. Julie Johnson. The winners of both runoffs will meet in the November general election.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 33;

-- TX-35: Both D and R runoffs on May 26
UPDATE house_races
SET notes = 'R primary runoff May 26: John Lujan vs. Carlos De La Cruz. D primary runoff May 26: Maureen Galindo vs. Johnny Garcia. The winners of both runoffs will meet in the November general election.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 35;

-- TX-38: R runoff, D nominee confirmed (Melissa McDonough)
UPDATE house_races
SET notes = 'R primary runoff May 26: Jon Bonck vs. Shelly deZevallos. Winner faces Democrat Melissa McDonough in the November general election.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 38;
